Sweep Backtest (SBT)

6300 optimizer configurations over one FIXED curation (data/cbt_3yr_v15) · no LLM, no re-curation · knobs from investor_profile.backtest.md

1. Parameter settings

The 6 FREE swept knobs — every combination is a cell, 4×3×7×3×5×5 = 6300 configs — and the values considered. These knobs only RE-WEIGHT a fixed set of curator picks, which is what makes the grid free: no LLM call is made and no event is discovered or closed differently. Every other optimizer / curator parameter is held at its investor_profile.backtest.md value.

parametervalues sweptcurrent (profile)
max_watchlist4, 6, 8, 124
concentration_cap0.25, 0.4, 0.60.6
lookback_period_days7, 10, 14, 21, 30, 45, 6045
drop_unfunded_weeks0, 2, 40
risk_aversion0.5, 1.0, 2.0, 3.0, 4.04.0
min_trade_size0.0, 0.05, 0.1, 0.2, 0.30.3

2. Return vs drawdown

The horizontal axis is max drawdown — the book's biggest peak-to-trough loss as a fraction of its running peak; further right = deeper loss. The vertical axis is annualized return, so upper-left is best. Each point is one config; colour is the share of the winners' gains handed back by the losers, so a pale point in the upper-left is the whole objective at once. The live config is the purple ★ star.

3. Return vs L1 churn

Same points, risk axis replaced by L1 churn = annualized one-way turnover (Σ|Δweight| across rebalances, ×100/yr): how much of the book is traded per year. Weights are held flat between rebalances, so drift never counts as a trade. Trading is free in an IRA, so read this as stability, not cost: lower churn = less noise-chasing and less overfit, making upper-left the sweet spot. Colour is Sharpe: a dark point at high churn is trading that actually pays for itself.

4. Return vs L2 course correction

Same idea, but the path length the book was dragged through weight-space (√ΣΔweight² per rebalance, summed and annualized). Against L1 it weights concentrated single-name rotations more heavily. The useful read is whether the two norms rank configs alike — if they do, the churn ordering is robust rather than an artefact of which norm was picked. Coloured by Sharpe, as panel 3.

5. Return vs cancellation

The fourth view of the same points, and the one that matters most: the horizontal axis is the share of the winners' gains handed back by the losers, so upper-left is best — a book that earns and keeps it. Colour is max drawdown, so a pale upper-left point earns well, keeps it, and does so without a deep hole. The cloud's shape is itself the finding: if it were a tight rising diagonal these knobs would only be trading return against cancellation, and it is not one.

6. Recommended settings

The shortlist: every config that clears all five gates read off panels 2–5 max DD < 65% · L1 < 1800%/yr · L2 < 1100/yr · cancelled < 60% — 1089 of 6,300 survive, ranked by Sharpe. There is deliberately NO churn gate: median Sharpe RISES monotonically with churn on this book (0.73 below L2 500, 1.17 above 900), so an L1/L2 ceiling was selecting for a book that barely trades. Trading is free in an IRA, so churn was only ever a proxy for drawdown — which is gated directly instead. plateau = ½·the config's own cancellation + ½·the mean of its grid neighbours, so a lone in-sample spike with weak surroundings still shows up. A ★ marks the survivor that is best on that column (plateau, cancellation, annualized return, Sharpe). Those four stars rarely land on one row — where they scatter IS the trade-off, and a config carrying two of them is the honest compromise. Top 30 shown; the rest expand below. Current live config on the last row.

7. risk_aversion × lookback_period_days

Median cancellation at each combination of the two knobs whose marginals span the widest range. This is the panel a 1-D sweep cannot produce, and it is where the interactions hide — a value that looks harmless on average can be the worst choice in one corner of the grid.

8. Each knob on its own

For every value of every knob: the MEDIAN cancellation across all cells holding that value (the bar) and the BEST single cell (the dot). A wide gap between them means the knob only pays in combination with something else. The live setting is outlined.
